calls.title: First 30 Day Sprint Review
calls.summary: The team convened to address gaps in deal ownership and improve the sales and renewal processes. Jeff Ignacio highlighted the need for a formal deal booking process to enhance pipeline accuracy, particularly through HubSpot and Retool. Ryan McGurk emphasized the importance of managing enterprise contracts effectively, particularly regarding renewals and pricing changes. The discussion included implementing a gated MEDDIC framework for better deal discipline and forecasting accuracy, as well as automating lead enrichment through Apollo and Zapier to streamline lead routing. A phased training approach was agreed upon to ensure reps adapt to the new processes without feeling overwhelmed. The meeting concluded with a focus on improving renewal management and operational visibility to drive revenue growth.
calls.keywords: HubSpot, Medpic, forecasting, lead enrichment, sales process, renewals
